text.en: Dietary supplements must be at least somewhat safe and effective, since a government regulator wouldn't allow a completely untested product to be sold -- in reality, in most jurisdictions including the United States, a supplement manufacturer does not need to prove safety or efficacy before selling a product, and the regulator's role is largely limited to removing a product from the market only after evidence of harm has already emerged, the reverse of the burden of proof a new medication has to clear before reaching a pharmacy shelf.
text.et: Toidulisandid peavad olema vähemalt mingil määral ohutud ja tõhusad, kuna valitsuse regulaator ei lubaks müüa täiesti testimata toodet -- tegelikult ei pea enamikus jurisdiktsioonides, sealhulgas Ameerika Ühendriikides, toidulisandi tootja tõestama ohutust ega tõhusust enne toote müümist, ning regulaatori roll piirdub suuresti toote turult eemaldamisega alles pärast seda, kui kahjustusest tõendid on juba ilmnenud, mis on vastupidine tõendamiskoormus sellele, mille uus ravim peab läbima enne apteegi riiulile jõudmist.
